Load libraries
```{r}
source("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Scripts/src/CellTFusion.R")
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
set.seed(123)
```

Load data
```{r}
# Megaclusters data
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
density_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")

# Spatial data
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")

### Replace '+' with 'plus' to avoid mismatches and change to a numeric matrix
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", colnames(x))
  x <- as.matrix(x)                     
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"       
  return(x)
})

counts = read.csv("../input/raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
coldata = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")

counts = counts[,rownames(coldata)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data

all.equal(rownames(coldata), colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order
```

Match with bulk
```{r}
# Entropy matrix
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

# Density matrix
df_density = density_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%rownames(df_entropy),]
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy) %in% colnames(counts),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density) %in% colnames(counts),]

df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(coldata),]

all.equal(rownames(df_entropy), colnames(counts))
all.equal(rownames(df_density), colnames(counts))

#Spatial data
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(df) {
  df <- df[rownames(df) %in% coldata$AN_clean, ]
  df = df[coldata$AN_clean,] #Order samples
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df <- df %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Samples = rownames(coldata)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples")
  return(df)
})

all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), rownames(coldata))
all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), colnames(counts))
```

Normalize counts
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

Markers
```{r}
cDC1_markers = c("CLEC9A", "XCR1", "HDAC9", "S100B", "IDO1", "CADM1", "CLNK", "CPVL", "WDFY4", "C1orf54", "DNASE1L3", "CPNE3", "CCSER1")
cDC2_markers = c("CLEC10A", "CD1C", "FCER1A", "FCGR2B", "CD1E", "AREG", "GPAT3") 
mature_DC_markers =c("LAMP3", "BIRC3", "CCR7", "MARCKS", "MARCKSL1", "FSCN1")
pDC_markers = c("PACSIN1", "GZMB", "IRF4", "C12orf75", "LILRA4", "IL3RA", "CLEC4C", "SPIB", "IGKC", "IRF7", "JCHAIN", "PTGDS")

markers_expression_cDC1 = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%cDC1_markers,]
markers_expression_cDC2 = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%cDC2_markers,]
markers_expression_DC_markers = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%mature_DC_markers,]
markers_expression_pDC = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%pDC_markers,]

dc_subtypes = c("cDC1_plus", "cDC2_plus", "Mature_DC_plus", "pDC_plus")
markers_expression = list(markers_expression_cDC1, markers_expression_cDC2, markers_expression_DC_markers, markers_expression_pDC)

data_spatial = do.call(cbind, data_spatial)

for (j in 1:length(dc_subtypes)) {
  spatial_data = data_spatial[,grep(dc_subtypes[j], colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F]
  compute.modules.relationship(spatial_data, t(markers_expression[[j]]), file_name = dc_subtypes[j], width = 10, height = 7)
}
```

Deconvolution MCPcounter
```{r}
mcp = MCPcounter::MCPcounter.estimate(counts.TPM.norm, featuresType = "HUGO_symbols", 
                                      genes = read.table("~/Documents/multideconv/inst/signatures/MCPcounter/MCPcounter-genes.txt", 
                                                         sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, 
                                                         colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE))

mcp = mcp[grep(paste0(c("DC", "DC1", "DC2", "Mature_DC"), collapse = '|'), rownames(mcp)),]
compute.modules.relationship(data_spatial, t(mcp), file_name = "DC_subtypes_MCP", width = 8, height = 15, cor_type = "s", pval = 0.05)
```

Deconvolution
```{r}
deconv = read.csv("../input/Deconvolution_Gobbini.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rownames(.)%in%colnames(counts))

deconv_subgroups = multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconvolution = deconv, 
                                                               corr = 0.85, 
                                                               seed = 123, 
                                                               file_name = "Gobbini", 
                                                               cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Plasma", "Tcells"),
                                                               return = TRUE) 

#deconv_subgroups = deconv_subgroups[[1]][,grep(paste0(c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3"), collapse = '|'), colnames(deconv_subgroups[[1]]))]
data_spatial = data_spatial[,grep(paste0(c("pDC", "cDC1", "cDC2", "Mature_DC"), collapse = '|'), colnames(data_spatial))]
compute.modules.relationship(deconv_subgroups, data_spatial, file_name = "DC_subtypes_deconv", width = 12, height = 15, cor_type = "s", pval = 1, par_mar = c(25, 20, 3, 3))
```

Add patient groups
```{r}
load("Patients_groups.RData")
patient_groups = patient_groups[rownames(patient_groups)%in%coldata$AN,]
coldata = coldata[coldata$AN%in%rownames(patient_groups),]
patient_groups = patient_groups[coldata$AN,]
all.equal(rownames(patient_groups), coldata$AN)
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = factor(patient_groups$Groups))
```


Immunoscores
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/immunoscores.R")

minMax <- function(x) {
  #columns: features
  x = data.matrix(x)
  for(i in 1:ncol(x)){
    x[,i] = (x[,i] - min(x[,i], na.rm = T)) / (max(x[,i], na.rm = T) - min(x[,i], na.rm = T))
  }

  return(x)

}

immunescores = compute_gold_standards(counts.norm.log)
```

```{r}
cell_groups = construct_cell_groups(counts.norm.log, tfs, deconv, network, deconv_subgroups, coldata, pval = 0.05, 
                                    high_corr_groups = 0.9, clustering.method = "ward.D2", trait = "R.NR", positive = "R")
```

Heatmaps
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Response = coldata$R.NR, 
  Groups = coldata$Groups,
  
  col = list(
    Response = c("R" = "green", "NR" = "red"),
    Groups = c("1" = "black", "2" = "yellow", "4" = "blue")
  ),
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)
```

Heatmap deconvolution
```{r}
#deconv_cbsx = deconv_cbsx[,colSums(deconv_cbsx)!=0]
deconv_mat = deconv_subgroups[[1]][,colnames(deconv_subgroups[[1]])%in%features]
ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(deconv_mat)),
        border = T, cluster_columns = F, column_split = coldata$Groups,
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"),
        name = "Deconvolution", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"),
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T,
        show_heatmap_legend = T,
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12),
        width = unit(20, "cm"), height = unit(25, "cm"),
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"),
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


pdf("Results/Deconvolution", width = 25, height = 15)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht1, show_heatmap_legend = T, heatmap_legend_side = "left", annotation_legend_side = 'left')
dev.off()

deconv_mcp = MCPcounter::MCPcounter.estimate(counts.TPM.norm, featuresType = "HUGO_symbols", 
                                      genes = read.table("~/Documents/multideconv/inst/signatures/MCPcounter/MCPcounter-genes.txt", 
                                                         sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, 
                                                         colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE))

deconv_cbsx = deconv[rownames(deconv)%in%rownames(coldata),grep("CBSX_CBSX.Zilionis.scRNAseq", colnames(deconv))]
deconv_cbsx = deconv_cbsx[,colSums(deconv_cbsx)!=0]
deconv_subgroups[[1]] = deconv_subgroups[[1]][rownames(deconv_subgroups[[1]])%in%rownames(coldata),]
compute.metada.association(t(deconv_mcp), coldata[,"Groups", drop = F])
compute.metada.association(deconv_subgroups[[1]], coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], ret)

```
